[[File:Star Wars Unlimited Spark of Rebellion Obi-Wan Kenobi.png|thumb|right|200px|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' (''Spark of Rebellion'', 2024).]]
'''''Star Wars'': Unlimited''' is a trading card game published by Fantasy Flight Games, part of Asmodee. Its first set, ''Spark of Rebellion'', was released on 8 March 2024.<ref name="sor" /> It is a different game from [[Star Wars CCG]]. Some SWCCG players also play it.

== Gameplay ==
Premier is the main constructed format. Each deck has at least 50 cards plus one leader and one base; a player wins a game by destroying the opponent's base.<ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Unlimited Star Wars: Unlimited], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260403001045/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Unlimited Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organized play ==
Fantasy Flight Games and Asmodee held the first Galactic Championship at The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas on 25–27 July 2025, advertised for over 2,000 players.<ref name="gc">[https://starwarsunlimited.com/articles/an-event-of-galactic-proportions An Event of Galactic Proportions], starwarsunlimited.com (5 February 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260313053626/https://starwarsunlimited.com/articles/an-event-of-galactic-proportions Internet Archive]</ref> Competitive events include Planetary Qualifiers, Sector Qualifiers and Regional Championships, with standings on melee.gg.

== SWCCG players ==
[[Timo Dusel]] plays ''Star Wars'': Unlimited on melee.gg as dillen.<ref name="melee">[https://melee.gg/Profile/Index/dillen melee.gg profile dillen]; [https://melee.gg/Tournament/View/452461 Berlin Sector Qualifier]; [https://melee.gg/Tournament/View/378340 Premium Sector Cup]; [https://melee.gg/Tournament/View/285530 Planetary Qualifier, FUNtainment GmbH]; [https://melee.gg/Tournament/View/202600 Planetary Qualifier Hof]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016204345/https://swccg.com/snapshots/melee/dillen-swu-results.html Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 3rd of 508 at the 15 August 2026 Berlin Sector Qualifier Premier Main Event (11–3–0).<ref name="melee" /> He finished 2nd of 152 at the 2 November 2025 Premium Sector Cup (6–0–0).<ref name="melee" /> He won the 10 May 2025 Planetary Qualifier hosted by FUNtainment GmbH (42 players, 8–1–0).<ref name="melee" /> He finished 2nd of 51 at the 26 January 2025 Planetary Qualifier in Hof (8–1–0).<ref name="melee" />
